rationale: Absolute mean signed calibration bias must be small
Numerical error must be useful relative to the 0-0.6 target grid
Empirical 95% calibration intervals must not severely undercover
Null positive-signal calls must be approximately calibrated
The estimator must preserve a useful ordering of loci
Null loci must not receive materially positive numerical h2 estimates on average
No simulated h2 level may have excessive mean calibration bias
